output: validated candidate/context records for canonical preprocessing; not input-001

record_id.decision_record_link: origin_record_id is retained in memory for a later redacted decision record

candidate.over_limit: reject that extracted candidate with an aggregate-only rejection code

canonical_preprocessing.behavior: reuse the canonical byte buffer and candidate-redacted semantic-context envelope exactly
canonical_preprocessing.normalized_context_over_limit: reject that extracted candidate with an aggregate-only rejection code

source_metadata: No legacy input-001 source object is invented. Extraction kind and optional corpus annotations remain in memory; provenance conventions remain a later owner decision.
labels: primary_label and artifact_family are retained only when supplied by corpus-001; unlabeled scans remain unlabeled.
reporting: CLI output may emit aggregate counts and rejection-code totals only. It must not emit paths, candidates, context, origin IDs, or labels.
